wiki.title: Lisa McClain
wiki.extract: Lisa Carmella McClain (née Iovannisci; born April 7, 1966) is an American politician who has represented Michigan's 9th congressional district since 2021. The district, numbered as the 10th during her first term, stretches from the outer northern suburbs of Detroit through The Thumb. A member of the Republican Party, McClain serves in congressional leadership as chair of the House Republican Conference.
